provider: CityUHK School of Energy and Environment JS1052 curriculum
note: The official Programme page publishes a 74-code integrated curriculum: named Gateway Education and College/School courses, 42 credits of College/School requirements, 72 credits of Environmental Science and Engineering plus Finance core courses, and two bounded 3-credit elective pools. The page metadata states a 154-credit graduation minimum while the curriculum introduction says 153 credits; the visible component headings total 34, 42 and 78 credits, but this conflict is not resolved by arithmetic inference. Distributional Gateway Education choices remain open, alternatives and six-credit double-counting also require manual review. The complete coded union is therefore browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
